statement: A slug MUST NOT be able to contain a glob metacharacter.
input_text: Should the reconciliation service retry failed batches?
note: The positive control for REC-063: an ordinary question produces a slug drawn only from [a-z0-9-]. This is the property REC-068's lookup pattern is built on -- the slug is interpolated directly into a glob, so it must never be able to contribute a metacharacter.
